proposal.name: recording pieces

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The bookkeeping starts in Init and changes only through the modeled requests, caller reports, crashes and launches.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesPreserved
statements.says: Every piece ever closed keeps its named bytes until the joined recording has been handed over and the caller reports that the three-day retention period has passed.

statements.name: WholePiecesAreDurable
statements.says: Every piece with its final name has all its bytes flushed to disk.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every bookkeeping field, caller effect and verification history has its declared type.

statements.name: OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole
statements.says: Before removal is allowed, every piece recorded as whole has its final name on disk.

statements.name: SettledInventoryMatchesDisk
statements.says: Whenever the bookkeeping is running outside an unresolved naming or removal operation, its inventory is exactly the pieces named on disk.

statements.name: ClosedNumbersNeverReused
statements.says: Closed pieces form the numbered sequence starting at one, and a new write always uses the number after the last closed piece.

statements.name: OnlyOneOpenPiece
statements.says: At most one piece has hidden bytes, and any open piece is the one immediately after the recorded closed pieces.

statements.name: NoMoreFromFailedCapture
statements.says: A write failure prevents any more pieces from that capture and remains recorded when the capture is finalized.

statements.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder
statements.says: Each join request contains every closed piece exactly once in increasing number order.

statements.name: JoinWaitsForFinalCapture
statements.says: Finishing the recording begins only after capture is final and no piece remains open.

statements.name: JoinRequestHasOnlyWholePieces
statements.says: Joining uses a nonempty set of closed pieces still present on disk and never starts another join over an already named joined file.

statements.name: JoinPublicationNeedsSavedManifest
statements.says: A named joined file always has a saved manifest matching its omitted pieces and their gap durations.

statements.name: EveryOmissionHasItsDuration
statements.says: A successful join preparation leaves at least one piece readable and records the duration of every omitted piece.

statements.name: OneJoinedFileOnly
statements.says: Every hand-over uses the recording’s stable identity and its single joined file, and no piece is handed over.

statements.name: HandoverRequiresSuccess
statements.says: A recording counts as handed over only after the hand-over has succeeded.

statements.name: RemovalWaitsThreeDaysAfterHandover
statements.says: Piece removal is requested only after successful hand-over and the caller’s report that three days have passed.

statements.name: FailedJoinKeepsRecording
statements.says: A failed join hands over nothing, preserves every closed piece, and records its failure reason.

statements.name: FailedHandoverKeepsRecording
statements.says: A reported hand-over failure keeps every closed piece and records the error without counting the recording as handed over.

statements.name: ErrorsIdentifySpool
statements.says: Every reported error identifies the recording’s spool location for the menu.

statements.name: InterruptionCountSurvivesRetries
statements.says: While running, the saved interruption count includes every interrupted join up to the limit and is never reset by a retry.

statements.name: InterruptedJoinStopsAtLimit
statements.says: An interrupted join awaiting cleanup as a failure has reached the interruption limit and reports that reason.

statements.name: EmptyMeansNothingRecorded
statements.says: A recording with no closed pieces finishes with nothing recorded and neither joins nor hands over a file.

statements.name: NamedPieceRecoveryUsesDisk
statements.says: Recovery accepts a piece named before the crash as closed even if its naming result was not saved.

statements.name: NamedJoinRecoveryUsesExistingFile
statements.says: Recovery of an already named joined file proceeds to hand-over using that file.

statements.name: InterruptedJoinRecovery
statements.says: Recovery discards an interrupted join’s partial output and schedules a retry below the interruption limit or reports failure at the limit.

statements.name: FailedJoinRetriesOnLaunch
statements.says: Launching after a failed join schedules its partial output cleanup and another join attempt.

statements.name: HandoverRetriesOnLaunch
statements.says: Launching after an unresolved or failed hand-over schedules another request for the same joined recording.

statements.name: RetryRequestRemainsPending
statements.says: A person’s retry request remains pending against the failed join or hand-over until it is scheduled or recovered at launch.

statements.name: SuccessfulHandover
statements.says: A recording can be joined and handed over without omissions.

statements.name: HandoverWithGap
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted and its duration reported as a gap.

statements.name: WriteFailureKept
statements.says: A failed write can discard the open remnant while preserving earlier closed pieces.

statements.name: JoinFailureKept
statements.says: A join can fail while every closed piece stays in the spool.

statements.name: NoneReadableKept
statements.says: A join that can read no piece can fail while keeping all the pieces.

statements.name: HandoverFailureKept
statements.says: Hand-over can fail after a successful join while all the pieces stay in the spool.

statements.name: NothingRecorded
statements.says: A capture with no closed piece can finish with nothing recorded.

statements.name: RetentionCompleted
statements.says: All pieces can be removed after successful hand-over and the retention period.

statements.name: InterruptionLimitReached
statements.says: Repeated interrupted joins can reach the limit and be reported as a failed join.

statements.name: SuccessAfterInterruptionLimit
statements.says: A later retry can succeed without resetting an interruption count that has already reached the limit.

statements.name: NamedPieceSurvivesUnrecordedCrash
statements.says: A crash can leave a whole named piece whose successful naming has not yet been recorded.

statements.name: NamedJoinSurvivesUnrecordedCrash
statements.says: A crash can leave a named joined file before the join success is recorded.

statements.name: UnresolvedHandoverSurvivesCrash
statements.says: A crash can occur after the archive receives the joined file but before hand-over success is recorded.

statements.name: CarriedOnWithNextPiece
statements.says: After recovering an unrecorded named piece, capture can carry on using the following piece number.

statements.name: PersonRetryReceived
statements.says: A person can request another attempt after a reported failure.

statements.name: NamedJoinRecovered
statements.says: A launch can recover an already named joined file and its saved gap manifest.

statements.name: PersonRetryProgress
statements.says: While the app keeps running, a pending request from the person eventually schedules join cleanup or hand-over.

statements.name: JoinRequestProgress
statements.says: While the app keeps running, a join ready to start is eventually requested.

statements.name: HandoverRequestProgress
statements.says: While the app keeps running, a hand-over ready to start is eventually requested.

statements.name: FinalCaptureProgress
statements.says: While the app keeps running, a final capture with no open piece eventually becomes ready to join or reports nothing recorded.

statements.name: RetentionRequestProgress
statements.says: While the app keeps running, expiry of the retention period eventually causes a piece removal request.

statements.name: FairRetryScheduling
statements.says: If scheduling a requested retry remains possible, the bookkeeping eventually schedules it.

statements.name: FairJoinRequest
statements.says: If issuing a join request remains possible, the bookkeeping eventually issues it.

statements.name: FairHandoverRequest
statements.says: If issuing a hand-over request remains possible, the bookkeeping eventually issues it.

statements.name: FairFinalization
statements.says: If finalizing the capture remains possible, the bookkeeping eventually finalizes it.

statements.name: FairRemovalRequest
statements.says: If issuing a piece removal request remains possible, the bookkeeping eventually issues it.

statements.name: RemoveBeforeHandover
statements.says: An implementation mistakenly removes a closed piece as soon as joining succeeds, before hand-over.

statements.name: NameBeforeFlush
statements.says: An implementation mistakenly names a piece before its bytes have been flushed.

statements.name: ForgetGapDurations
statements.says: An implementation mistakenly loses saved gap durations after naming the joined file.

statements.name: ResetInterruptionCount
statements.says: An implementation mistakenly resets the interruption count when retrying a failed join.

statements.name: RejoinNamedOutput
statements.says: An implementation mistakenly starts joining again despite an already named joined file.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingPieces ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, InterruptionLimit, Durations, RecordingId, SpoolPath
VARIABLES online, phase, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
          known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
          gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
          handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver, retentionElapsed,
          error, errorAt, retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply

vars == <<online, phase, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
          known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
          gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
          handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver, retentionElapsed,
          error, errorAt, retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces
Phases == {"Capture", "Write", "Name", "DiscardPiece", "JoinReady", "Join",
           "PublishJoin", "DiscardJoinRetry", "DiscardJoinFailed", "JoinFailed",
           "HandoverReady", "Handover", "HandoverFailed", "Retained", "Remove",
           "Done", "Empty"}
Errors == {"", "write failed", "join failed", "none readable",
           "interruption limit", "handover failed"}
Named == {p \in Pieces : disk[p] = "named"}
ClosedOrder == [i \in 1..Cardinality(sealed) |-> i]
ZeroGaps == [p \in Pieces |-> 0]
GapReport(missing) == [p \in Pieces |-> IF p \in missing THEN durations[p] ELSE 0]
MayRemove == handedOver /\ retentionElapsed
FinishPhases == {"JoinReady", "Join", "PublishJoin", "DiscardJoinRetry",
                 "DiscardJoinFailed", "JoinFailed", "HandoverReady", "Handover",
                 "HandoverFailed", "Retained", "Remove", "Done", "Empty"}

\* One instance owns one recording and its stable spool location.  The piece
\* bound limits the exploration, not the implementation's recording length.
\* disk, durable, contents, partial, joined, fileOmitted and delivered abstract
\* caller-owned effects.  sealed and interruptionEvidence are history used only
\* for verification; recoveryKind and recoveryReply record the last reconciliation
\* decision for checking its response.  The other fields form the atomically saved bookkeeping.
\* Each phase requesting an effect is saved before any caller action can run.
\* A hidden piece may survive a crash in any write state; recovery discards it.
\* Durations are supplied metadata; this model does not inspect media bytes.
TypeOK ==
    /\ retryPending \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recoveryKind \in {"none", "named piece", "named join", "interrupted join", "interruption limit",
                         "handover", "failed join", "failed handover"}
    /\ recoveryReply \in Phases \cup {"none"}
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ capture \in {"active", "paused", "failed", "final"}
    /\ open \in 0..MaxPieces
    /\ disk \in [Pieces -> {"absent", "hidden", "named"}]
    /\ durable \subseteq Pieces
    /\ contents \in [Pieces -> 0..2]
    /\ durations \in [Pieces -> (Durations \cup {0})]
    /\ known \subseteq Pieces
    /\ sealed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ captureFault \in BOOLEAN
    /\ joinInput \in UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}
    /\ partial \in BOOLEAN
    /\ prepared \in BOOLEAN
    /\ omitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ gaps \in [Pieces -> (Durations \cup {0})]
    /\ joined \in BOOLEAN
    /\ fileOmitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ interruptions \in 0..InterruptionLimit
    /\ interruptionEvidence \in 0..InterruptionLimit
    /\ handoverKey = RecordingId
    /\ handoverTarget \in 0..MaxPieces
    /\ delivered \subseteq 0..MaxPieces
    /\ handedOver \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retentionElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ error \in Errors
    /\ errorAt \in {"", SpoolPath}

ClosedPiecesPreserved ==
    ~MayRemove => \A p \in sealed : disk[p] = "named" /\ contents[p] = 1

WholePiecesAreDurable == Named \subseteq durable

OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole ==
    ~MayRemove => known \subseteq Named

SettledInventoryMatchesDisk ==
    online /\ phase \notin {"Name", "Remove"} => known = Named

ClosedNumbersNeverReused ==
    /\ sealed = 1..Cardinality(sealed)
    /\ phase = "Write" => open = Cardinality(sealed) + 1 /\ open \notin sealed

OnlyOneOpenPiece ==
    /\ {p \in Pieces : disk[p] = "hidden"} \subseteq {open}
    /\ phase \notin {"Write", "Name", "DiscardPiece"} => open = 0
    /\ open # 0 => open = Cardinality(known) + 1

NoMoreFromFailedCapture == captureFault => capture \in {"failed", "final"}

JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder ==
    joinInput # <<>> => joinInput = ClosedOrder

JoinWaitsForFinalCapture ==
    phase \in FinishPhases => capture = "final" /\ open = 0

JoinRequestHasOnlyWholePieces ==
    phase \in {"JoinReady", "Join", "PublishJoin", "DiscardJoinRetry",
                "DiscardJoinFailed", "JoinFailed"}
        => /\ sealed # {}
           /\ Named = sealed
           /\ (~joined \/ phase = "PublishJoin")

JoinPublicationNeedsSavedManifest ==
    joined => prepared /\ omitted = fileOmitted /\ omitted \subseteq sealed
              /\ omitted # sealed /\ gaps = GapReport(omitted)

EveryOmissionHasItsDuration ==
    prepared => omitted \subseteq sealed /\ omitted # sealed
                /\ gaps = GapReport(omitted)
                /\ \A p \in omitted : gaps[p] \in Durations

OneJoinedFileOnly ==
    /\ handoverTarget = 0
    /\ delivered \subseteq {0}
    /\ delivered # {} => joined
    /\ phase = "Handover" => joined /\ handoverKey = RecordingId

HandoverRequiresSuccess ==
    /\ handedOver => delivered = {0} /\ joined
    /\ phase \in {"Retained", "Remove", "Done"} => handedOver
    /\ retentionElapsed => handedOver

RemovalWaitsThreeDaysAfterHandover ==
    phase \in {"Remove", "Done"} => MayRemove

FailedJoinKeepsRecording ==
    phase \in {"JoinFailed", "DiscardJoinFailed"}
        => ~joined /\ ~handedOver /\ delivered = {} /\ Named = sealed
           /\ error \in {"join failed", "none readable", "interruption limit"}

FailedHandoverKeepsRecording ==
    phase = "HandoverFailed"
        => ~handedOver /\ joined /\ Named = sealed /\ error = "handover failed"

ErrorsIdentifySpool == error # "" => errorAt = SpoolPath

InterruptionCountSurvivesRetries ==
    online => interruptions = interruptionEvidence

InterruptedJoinStopsAtLimit ==
    phase = "DiscardJoinFailed"
        => interruptions = InterruptionLimit /\ error = "interruption limit"

EmptyMeansNothingRecorded ==
    phase = "Empty" => sealed = {} /\ ~joined /\ delivered = {} /\ ~handedOver

NamedPieceRecoveryUsesDisk ==
    recoveryKind = "named piece" => recoveryReply = "Capture"

NamedJoinRecoveryUsesExistingFile ==
    recoveryKind = "named join" => recoveryReply = "HandoverReady"

InterruptedJoinRecovery ==
    /\ recoveryKind = "interrupted join" => recoveryReply = "DiscardJoinRetry"
    /\ recoveryKind = "interruption limit" => recoveryReply = "DiscardJoinFailed"

FailedJoinRetriesOnLaunch ==
    recoveryKind = "failed join" => recoveryReply = "DiscardJoinRetry"

HandoverRetriesOnLaunch ==
    recoveryKind \in {"handover", "failed handover"} => recoveryReply = "HandoverReady"

RetryRequestRemainsPending ==
    retryPending => phase \in {"JoinFailed", "HandoverFailed"}

PersonRetryProgress ==
    (online /\ retryPending)
        ~> (~online \/ phase \in {"DiscardJoinRetry", "HandoverReady"})

JoinRequestProgress ==
    (online /\ phase = "JoinReady") ~> (~online \/ phase = "Join")
HandoverRequestProgress ==
    (online /\ phase = "HandoverReady") ~> (~online \/ phase = "Handover")
FinalCaptureProgress ==
    (online /\ phase = "Capture" /\ capture = "final")
        ~> (~online \/ phase \in {"JoinReady", "Empty"})
RetentionRequestProgress ==
    (online /\ phase = "Retained" /\ retentionElapsed)
        ~> (~online \/ phase = "Remove")

SuccessfulHandover == handedOver /\ omitted = {} /\ sealed # {}
HandoverWithGap == handedOver /\ omitted # {} /\ omitted # sealed
WriteFailureKept == captureFault /\ phase = "Capture" /\ sealed # {} /\ Named = sealed
JoinFailureKept == phase = "JoinFailed" /\ error = "join failed" /\ Named = sealed
NoneReadableKept == phase = "JoinFailed" /\ error = "none readable" /\ Named = sealed
HandoverFailureKept == phase = "HandoverFailed" /\ Named = sealed
NothingRecorded == phase = "Empty"
RetentionCompleted == phase = "Done" /\ Named = {} /\ sealed # {}
InterruptionLimitReached == phase = "JoinFailed" /\ error = "interruption limit"
SuccessAfterInterruptionLimit == handedOver /\ interruptions = InterruptionLimit
NamedPieceSurvivesUnrecordedCrash == ~online /\ Named # known /\ phase = "Name"
NamedJoinSurvivesUnrecordedCrash == ~online /\ phase = "PublishJoin" /\ joined
UnresolvedHandoverSurvivesCrash == ~online /\ phase = "Handover" /\ delivered = {0}
CarriedOnWithNextPiece ==
    phase = "Write" /\ open = 2 /\ known = {1} /\ recoveryKind = "named piece"
PersonRetryReceived == retryPending
NamedJoinRecovered == online /\ recoveryKind = "named join" /\ joined

Init ==
    /\ retryPending = FALSE
    /\ recoveryKind = "none"
    /\ recoveryReply = "none"
    /\ online = TRUE
    /\ phase = "Capture"
    /\ capture = "active"
    /\ open = 0
    /\ disk = [p \in Pieces |-> "absent"]
    /\ durable = {}
    /\ contents = [p \in Pieces |-> 0]
    /\ durations = [p \in Pieces |-> 0]
    /\ known = {}
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ captureFault = FALSE
    /\ joinInput = <<>>
    /\ partial = FALSE
    /\ prepared = FALSE
    /\ omitted = {}
    /\ gaps = ZeroGaps
    /\ joined = FALSE
    /\ fileOmitted = {}
    /\ interruptions = 0
    /\ interruptionEvidence = 0
    /\ handoverKey = RecordingId
    /\ handoverTarget = 0
    /\ delivered = {}
    /\ handedOver = FALSE
    /\ retentionElapsed = FALSE
    /\ error = ""
    /\ errorAt = ""

AcceptPiece(seconds) ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Capture" /\ capture = "active" /\ ~captureFault
    /\ Cardinality(known) < MaxPieces
    /\ disk[Cardinality(known) + 1] = "absent"
    /\ open' = Cardinality(known) + 1
    /\ durations' = [durations EXCEPT ![Cardinality(known) + 1] = seconds]
    /\ phase' = "Write"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, disk, durable, contents, known, sealed,
                   captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted, gaps,
                   joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

WriteHiddenBytes ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Write" /\ disk[open] = "absent"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT ![open] = "hidden"]
    /\ contents' = [contents EXCEPT ![open] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, durable, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

FlushPiece ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Write" /\ disk[open] = "hidden" /\ open \notin durable
    /\ durable' = durable \cup {open}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, disk, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportPieceFlushed ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Write" /\ open \in durable
    /\ phase' = "Name"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions,
                   interruptionEvidence, handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered,
                   handedOver, retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Name" /\ disk[open] = "hidden" /\ open \in durable
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT ![open] = "named"]
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {open}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportPieceNamed ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Name" /\ open \in Named
    /\ known' = Named
    /\ open' = 0
    /\ phase' = "Capture"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, disk, durable, contents, durations, sealed,
                   captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted, gaps,
                   joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportWriteFailure ==
    /\ online /\ phase \in {"Write", "Name"} /\ open \notin Named
    /\ capture' = IF capture = "final" THEN "final" ELSE "failed"
    /\ captureFault' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = "DiscardPiece"
    /\ error' = "write failed"
    /\ errorAt' = SpoolPath
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, open, disk, durable, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted, gaps, joined,
                   fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence, handoverKey,
                   handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver, retentionElapsed>>

DiscardOpenRemnant ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "DiscardPiece" /\ disk[open] = "hidden"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT ![open] = "absent"]
    /\ durable' = durable \ {open}
    /\ contents' = [contents EXCEPT ![open] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, durations, known, sealed,
                   captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted, gaps,
                   joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportRemnantDiscarded ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "DiscardPiece" /\ disk[open] = "absent"
    /\ open' = 0
    /\ phase' = "Capture"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, disk, durable, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

CaptureEnded ==
    /\ online /\ capture = "active" /\ phase \in {"Capture", "Write", "Name"}
    /\ capture' = "paused"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, open, disk, durable, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

CarryOn ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Capture" /\ capture = "paused" /\ ~captureFault
    /\ capture' = "active"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, open, disk, durable, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

FinishCapture ==
    /\ online /\ phase \in {"Capture", "Write", "Name", "DiscardPiece"}
    /\ capture # "final"
    /\ capture' = "final"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, open, disk, durable, contents, durations, known,
                   sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared, omitted,
                   gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

FinalizeCapture ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Capture" /\ capture = "final" /\ open = 0
    /\ phase' = IF known = {} THEN "Empty" ELSE "JoinReady"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions,
                   interruptionEvidence, handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered,
                   handedOver, retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

RequestJoin ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "JoinReady" /\ ~joined /\ ~partial
    /\ phase' = "Join"
    /\ joinInput' = [i \in 1..Cardinality(known) |-> i]
    /\ prepared' = FALSE
    /\ omitted' = {}
    /\ gaps' = ZeroGaps
    /\ error' = ""
    /\ errorAt' = ""
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, partial, joined, fileOmitted,
                   interruptions, interruptionEvidence, handoverKey,
                   handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver, retentionElapsed>>

BeginJoinOutput ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Join" /\ ~partial /\ ~joined
    /\ partial' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, disk, durable, contents,
                   durations, known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions,
                   interruptionEvidence, handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered,
                   handedOver, retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportJoinPrepared(missing) ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "Join" /\ partial /\ ~joined
    /\ missing \subseteq known /\ missing # known
    /\ phase' = "PublishJoin"
    /\ prepared' = TRUE
    /\ omitted' = missing
    /\ gaps' = GapReport(missing)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, joined,
                   fileOmitted, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

NameJoinedFile ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "PublishJoin" /\ partial /\ prepared /\ ~joined
    /\ joined' = TRUE
    /\ partial' = FALSE
    /\ fileOmitted' = omitted
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, phase, capture, open, disk, durable, contents,
                   durations, known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, interruptions, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportJoinNamed ==
    /\ online /\ phase = "PublishJoin" /\ joined
    /\ phase' = "HandoverReady"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions,
                   interruptionEvidence, handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered,
                   handedOver, retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

ReportJoinFailure(reason) ==
    /\ online /\ phase \in {"Join", "PublishJoin"} /\ ~joined
    /\ reason \in {"join failed", "none readable"}
    /\ reason = "none readable" => phase = "Join" /\ partial
    /\ phase' = "JoinFailed"
    /\ prepared' = FALSE
    /\ omitted' = {}
    /\ gaps' = ZeroGaps
    /\ error' = reason
    /\ errorAt' = SpoolPath
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, online, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,

Crash ==
    /\ online
    /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ interruptionEvidence' =
        IF phase \in {"Join", "PublishJoin"} /\ ~joined
        THEN IF interruptionEvidence < InterruptionLimit
             THEN interruptionEvidence + 1 ELSE interruptionEvidence
        ELSE interruptionEvidence
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPending, recoveryKind, recoveryReply, phase, capture, open, disk, durable, contents, durations,
                   known, sealed, captureFault, joinInput, partial, prepared,
                   omitted, gaps, joined, fileOmitted, interruptions,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver,
                   retentionElapsed, error, errorAt>>

\* Launch consumes an authoritative disk listing and saves the reconciled
\* record before enabling effects.  Naming the joined file is the commit point.
\* An interruption reaching the bound is shown as failure on this launch;
\* another launch or an explicit retry may start another attempt, without
\* resetting the cumulative, saturated interruption count.
Launch ==
    /\ ~online
    /\ LET lostJoin == phase \in {"Join", "PublishJoin"} /\ ~joined
           count == IF lostJoin /\ interruptions < InterruptionLimit
                    THEN interruptions + 1 ELSE interruptions
       IN /\ online' = TRUE
          /\ retryPending' = FALSE
          /\ recoveryKind' =
              CASE phase \in {"Write", "Name", "DiscardPiece"} ->
                       IF open \in Named THEN "named piece" ELSE "none"
                [] phase \in {"Join", "PublishJoin"} ->
                       IF joined THEN "named join"
                       ELSE IF count >= InterruptionLimit
                            THEN "interruption limit" ELSE "interrupted join"
                [] phase \in {"JoinFailed", "DiscardJoinFailed"} -> "failed join"
                [] phase = "Handover" -> "handover"
                [] phase = "HandoverFailed" -> "failed handover"
                [] OTHER -> "none"
          /\ known' = Named
          /\ capture' = IF capture = "active" THEN "paused" ELSE capture
          /\ open' = IF open \in Named THEN 0 ELSE open
          /\ interruptions' = count
          /\ phase' =
              CASE phase \in {"Write", "Name", "DiscardPiece"} ->
                       IF open \in Named THEN "Capture" ELSE "DiscardPiece"
                [] phase \in {"Join", "PublishJoin"} ->
                       IF joined THEN "HandoverReady"
                       ELSE IF count >= InterruptionLimit
                            THEN "DiscardJoinFailed" ELSE "DiscardJoinRetry"
                [] phase \in {"JoinFailed", "DiscardJoinFailed"} -> "DiscardJoinRetry"
                [] phase \in {"Handover", "HandoverFailed"} -> "HandoverReady"
                [] OTHER -> phase
          /\ recoveryReply' = IF recoveryKind' = "none" THEN "none" ELSE phase'
          /\ prepared' = IF lostJoin THEN FALSE ELSE prepared
          /\ omitted' = IF lostJoin THEN {} ELSE omitted
          /\ gaps' = IF lostJoin THEN ZeroGaps ELSE gaps
          /\ error' = IF lostJoin /\ count >= InterruptionLimit
                       THEN "interruption limit" ELSE error
          /\ errorAt' = IF lostJoin /\ count >= InterruptionLimit
                         THEN SpoolPath ELSE errorAt
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, durable, contents, durations, sealed, captureFault,
                   joinInput, partial, joined, fileOmitted, interruptionEvidence,
                   handoverKey, handoverTarget, delivered, handedOver, retentionElapsed>>

Finished == online /\ phase \in {"Done", "Empty"} /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E seconds \in Durations : AcceptPiece(seconds)
    \/ WriteHiddenBytes
    \/ FlushPiece
    \/ ReportPieceFlushed
    \/ NamePiece
    \/ ReportPieceNamed
    \/ ReportWriteFailure
    \/ DiscardOpenRemnant
    \/ ReportRemnantDiscarded
    \/ CaptureEnded

    \/ \E missing \in SUBSET Pieces : ReportJoinPrepared(missing)

    \/ AskRetry

    \/ RequestHandover
    \/ DeliverJoinedFile
    \/ ReportHandoverSuccess
    \/ ReportHandoverFailure
    \/ ReportThreeDaysElapsed
    \/ RequestRemoval
    \/ \E p \in Pieces : RemovePiece(p)
    \/ ReportRemovalComplete
    \/ Crash
    \/ Launch
    \/ Finished

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The bookkeeping starts in Init and changes only through the modeled requests, caller reports, crashes and launches.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesPreserved
pins.says: Every piece ever closed keeps its named bytes until the joined recording has been handed over and the caller reports that the three-day retention period has passed.

pins.name: WholePiecesAreDurable
pins.says: Every piece with its final name has all its bytes flushed to disk.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every bookkeeping field, caller effect and verification history has its declared type.

pins.name: OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole
pins.says: Before removal is allowed, every piece recorded as whole has its final name on disk.

pins.name: SettledInventoryMatchesDisk
pins.says: Whenever the bookkeeping is running outside an unresolved naming or removal operation, its inventory is exactly the pieces named on disk.

pins.name: ClosedNumbersNeverReused
pins.says: Closed pieces form the numbered sequence starting at one, and a new write always uses the number after the last closed piece.

pins.name: OnlyOneOpenPiece
pins.says: At most one piece has hidden bytes, and any open piece is the one immediately after the recorded closed pieces.

pins.name: NoMoreFromFailedCapture
pins.says: A write failure prevents any more pieces from that capture and remains recorded when the capture is finalized.

pins.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPieceInOrder
pins.says: Each join request contains every closed piece exactly once in increasing number order.

pins.name: JoinWaitsForFinalCapture
pins.says: Finishing the recording begins only after capture is final and no piece remains open.

pins.name: JoinRequestHasOnlyWholePieces
pins.says: Joining uses a nonempty set of closed pieces still present on disk and never starts another join over an already named joined file.

pins.name: JoinPublicationNeedsSavedManifest
pins.says: A named joined file always has a saved manifest matching its omitted pieces and their gap durations.

pins.name: EveryOmissionHasItsDuration
pins.says: A successful join preparation leaves at least one piece readable and records the duration of every omitted piece.

pins.name: OneJoinedFileOnly
pins.says: Every hand-over uses the recording’s stable identity and its single joined file, and no piece is handed over.

pins.name: HandoverRequiresSuccess
pins.says: A recording counts as handed over only after the hand-over has succeeded.

pins.name: RemovalWaitsThreeDaysAfterHandover
pins.says: Piece removal is requested only after successful hand-over and the caller’s report that three days have passed.

pins.name: FailedJoinKeepsRecording
pins.says: A failed join hands over nothing, preserves every closed piece, and records its failure reason.

pins.name: FailedHandoverKeepsRecording
pins.says: A reported hand-over failure keeps every closed piece and records the error without counting the recording as handed over.

pins.name: ErrorsIdentifySpool
pins.says: Every reported error identifies the recording’s spool location for the menu.

pins.name: InterruptionCountSurvivesRetries
pins.says: While running, the saved interruption count includes every interrupted join up to the limit and is never reset by a retry.

pins.name: InterruptedJoinStopsAtLimit
pins.says: An interrupted join awaiting cleanup as a failure has reached the interruption limit and reports that reason.

pins.name: EmptyMeansNothingRecorded
pins.says: A recording with no closed pieces finishes with nothing recorded and neither joins nor hands over a file.

pins.name: NamedPieceRecoveryUsesDisk
pins.says: Recovery accepts a piece named before the crash as closed even if its naming result was not saved.

pins.name: NamedJoinRecoveryUsesExistingFile
pins.says: Recovery of an already named joined file proceeds to hand-over using that file.

pins.name: InterruptedJoinRecovery
pins.says: Recovery discards an interrupted join’s partial output and schedules a retry below the interruption limit or reports failure at the limit.

pins.name: FailedJoinRetriesOnLaunch
pins.says: Launching after a failed join schedules its partial output cleanup and another join attempt.

pins.name: HandoverRetriesOnLaunch
pins.says: Launching after an unresolved or failed hand-over schedules another request for the same joined recording.

pins.name: RetryRequestRemainsPending
pins.says: A person’s retry request remains pending against the failed join or hand-over until it is scheduled or recovered at launch.

pins.name: SuccessfulHandover
pins.says: A recording can be joined and handed over without omissions.

pins.name: HandoverWithGap
pins.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted and its duration reported as a gap.

pins.name: WriteFailureKept
pins.says: A failed write can discard the open remnant while preserving earlier closed pieces.

pins.name: JoinFailureKept
pins.says: A join can fail while every closed piece stays in the spool.

pins.name: NoneReadableKept
pins.says: A join that can read no piece can fail while keeping all the pieces.

pins.name: HandoverFailureKept
pins.says: Hand-over can fail after a successful join while all the pieces stay in the spool.

pins.name: NothingRecorded
pins.says: A capture with no closed piece can finish with nothing recorded.

pins.name: RetentionCompleted
pins.says: All pieces can be removed after successful hand-over and the retention period.

pins.name: InterruptionLimitReached
pins.says: Repeated interrupted joins can reach the limit and be reported as a failed join.

pins.name: SuccessAfterInterruptionLimit
pins.says: A later retry can succeed without resetting an interruption count that has already reached the limit.

pins.name: NamedPieceSurvivesUnrecordedCrash
pins.says: A crash can leave a whole named piece whose successful naming has not yet been recorded.

pins.name: NamedJoinSurvivesUnrecordedCrash
pins.says: A crash can leave a named joined file before the join success is recorded.

pins.name: UnresolvedHandoverSurvivesCrash
pins.says: A crash can occur after the archive receives the joined file but before hand-over success is recorded.

pins.name: CarriedOnWithNextPiece
pins.says: After recovering an unrecorded named piece, capture can carry on using the following piece number.

pins.name: PersonRetryReceived
pins.says: A person can request another attempt after a reported failure.

pins.name: NamedJoinRecovered
pins.says: A launch can recover an already named joined file and its saved gap manifest.

usage.summary: Created `RecordingPieces.tla`, `proposal.json`, and `view.json`, preserving decisions F1–F4. All checks passed across 17,792 states, including every witness, progress property, and five hypothetical bugs; the model exceeds the 500-state chart limit.

answers.question: If On Air dies after the joined file gets its name but before the join result is saved, how should the gap information survive?
answers.says: The caller reports the omitted pieces and gap durations before naming the joined file, and waits until this part has saved them.

answers.question: If On Air dies during hand-over before its result is saved, how should this part recover the unresolved hand-over?
answers.says: The part retries the same hand-over request after recovery, and the hand-over part deduplicates it using the recording’s stable identity.

answers.question: After hand-over explicitly reports failure, should this part retry it at the next launch or wait for the person to ask?
answers.says: Retry the same hand-over at the next launch and whenever the person asks.

answers.question: When a failed join is retried, should its count of earlier crash interruptions reset?
answers.says: Retrying a failed join keeps its earlier crash-interruption count, so after the limit is reached any further interrupted attempt reports failure.
